items.problem: MediaElement -> MediaPlayerElement is documented as a trivial namespace/element swap, but the two controls have different API surfaces. MediaPlayerElement exposes no Play/Pause/Stop/SetSource/AudioCategory/AutoPlay/CurrentState members; all playback moves to a Windows.Media.Playback.MediaPlayer.
items.evidence: Migrated PlaybackControl.xaml.cs (app) re-architects to OutputMedia.SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()), OutputMedia.MediaPlayer.Play()/Pause(), Stop()=Pause()+PlaybackSession.Position=TimeSpan.Zero, MediaPlayer.Source=MediaSource.CreateFromStream(stream, contentType), SetAudioCategory(MediaPlayerAudioCategory), mediaPlayer.SystemMediaTransportControls. UWP source PlaybackControl.xaml.cs used OutputMedia.Play()/Pause()/Stop()/SetSource()/AudioCategory directly on the MediaElement.
items.wrong_text_if_any: line 362 '| `MediaElement` | `MediaPlayerElement` (Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls) |' and line 569 '| `<MediaElement … />` | `<MediaPlayerElement … />` | Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames. |'
items.root_cause: The 'controls' anchor (the destination Initialize-UwpMigration routes a MediaElement TODO to) implies a 1:1 element swap, so the guidance actively understates the required MediaElement->MediaPlayer split.
items.proposed_fix: Correct both rows and add a focused MediaElement->MediaPlayerElement mapping in the 'controls' section: SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()); playback methods on element.MediaPlayer; Stop() = Pause()+PlaybackSession.Position=TimeSpan.Zero; MediaPlayer.Source = MediaSource.CreateFromStream/Uri(...); AudioCategory enum Windows.UI.Xaml.Media.AudioCategory -> Windows.Media.Playback.MediaPlayerAudioCategory; MediaElementState -> MediaPlaybackState.
items.generalizes: Every UWP media-playback sample drives a MediaElement with element-level Play/Pause/Stop/Source/AudioCategory; all of them must perform this same re-architecture on WinUI 3, so the corrected mapping applies broadly (not specific to AudioCategory).
